business_summary: Guangdong Wanlima Industry Co. ,Ltd engages in the research, design, production, manufacture, and marketing of leather products in China and internationally. It primarily offers handbags, wallets, trolley cases, leather shoes, and belts; fashion accessories, such as glasses, scarves, keychains, etc.; and military and police protective equipment, portable gear, polymer composite material equipment, protective gear, security gear, emergency rescue equipment, riot control and bomb disposal products, and other military, police, and social security protection equipment. The company markets its products under the Wanlima, Saint Jack, and Coome brands. Guangdong Wanlima Industry Co. ,Ltd was founded in 1993 and is based in Guangzhou, China.
